completion_promises.criterion_text: KeycloakIdentityProvider implements the 3-member IdentityProvider port unchanged, with a sync currentPrincipal backed by an in-memory cached principal
completion_promises.evidence: KeycloakIdentityProvider class implements IdentityProvider interface with sync getter currentPrincipal that returns _currentPrincipal (in-memory cached Principal). Implementation verified in keycloak_identity_provider.dart lines 41-54.

completion_promises.criterion_text: signIn() attempts a silent refresh of the stored session before opening the browser, and opens the interactive PKCE S256 browser flow only when silent refresh is unavailable/fails
completion_promises.evidence: _performSignIn() method first attempts silent refresh using stored session (lines 76-84), falling through to interactive flow only if silent refresh fails. PKCE S256 is flutter_appauth default for public clients. Test 'a valid stored session refreshes silently' verifies no interactive flow called when silent succeeds.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The interactive flow uses KeycloakConfig.redirectUrl (com.appmilla.studytutor:/oauth2redirect) and requests offline_access, and completes after the custom-scheme redirect returns the app to the foreground
completion_promises.evidence: _interactiveSignIn() method (line 113-134) uses _config.redirectUrl and _config.scopes in AuthorizationTokenRequest. KeycloakConfig.scopes is frozen to ['openid', 'offline_access'] (per keycloak_config.dart line 51). Custom-scheme redirect completion is handled by flutter_appauth library.

completion_promises.criterion_text: signIn() surfaces cancel and failure as distinct outcomes (§4 SIGNIN_OUTCOME) and never conflates them
completion_promises.evidence: Defined two distinct exception types: SignInCancelled (lines 20-27) and SignInFailed (lines 29-38). _interactiveSignIn() catches FlutterAppAuthPlatformException and distinguishes cancel via _isCancelError() (lines 128-133, 136-141). Test 'cancel and failure surface as distinct outcomes' verifies both exception types are thrown correctly.

completion_promises.criterion_text: A second signIn() while one is in flight starts no second flow (single-flight)
completion_promises.evidence: signIn() method implements single-flight guard using _signInInFlight field (lines 57-72). If _signInInFlight is not null, returns the existing future. Test 'second concurrent signIn shares one flow' verifies only 1 interactive call despite 3 concurrent signIn() calls.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The adapter refreshes proactively before access-token expiry using the appauth token-response expiry, so an idle longer than the access-token lifetime does not force a re-sign-in while the offline session is valid (KC-G3)
completion_promises.evidence: _scheduleProactiveRefresh() method (lines 198-213) schedules Timer to refresh 5 minutes before TokenResponse.accessTokenExpirationDateTime. Called after successful sign-in and after each background refresh (line 172, 244). Test 'refreshes before access token expiry' verifies proactive refresh with soon-expiring token.

completion_promises.criterion_text: signOut() clears the secure store and cached principal and wins over an in-flight background refresh — a refresh completing after sign-out does not restore the session
completion_promises.evidence: signOut() increments _generation counter (line 250) to invalidate in-flight refreshes. _performBackgroundRefresh() captures generation at start (line 216) and checks it again after async operations (lines 239-242), discarding results if generation changed. Test 'wins over in-flight refresh' verifies principal stays null after sign-out despite completing refresh.

completion_promises.criterion_text: An unrecoverable background refresh leaves currentPrincipal == null and degrades to the sign-in fallback rather than crashing or hanging
completion_promises.evidence: _performBackgroundRefresh() wraps token refresh in try-catch (lines 218-236). On exception, sets _currentPrincipal = null and clears store (lines 231-234), never propagating exception. Test 'unrecoverable refresh clears principal without throwing' verifies degradation without throwing.

completion_promises.criterion_text: At launch an absent/unreadable/offline-expired stored session is treated as signed out
completion_promises.evidence: _currentPrincipal initializes to null (line 48). _performSignIn() checks stored session; if null or expired (lines 76-84), proceeds to interactive flow. SecureSessionStore.read() returns null for absent/unreadable sessions (per secure_session_store.dart). Tests 'absent stored session treated as signed out' and 'unreadable stored session treated as signed out' verify this behavior.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Hermetic tests fake FlutterAppAuth and SecureSessionStore — no browser, no network, no platform channel
completion_promises.evidence: Test file implements FakeAppAuth (lines 301-392) that implements FlutterAppAuth interface and tracks calls without platform channels, and FakeSecureSessionStore (lines 395-428) that implements SecureSessionStore with in-memory storage. All tests use these fakes, ensuring hermetic execution.
